task: Add concurrency guards to GitHub Actions workflows so a rapid push does not leave duplicate/overlapping CI runs on the same ref

events.summary: Workflow-file edits only; no cmd/internal/charts/Dockerfile/scripts runtime logic touched
Confirmed no workflow in .github/workflows/ had a concurrency block prior to this change, verified via grep across all workflow files

Added concurrency: {group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: <bool>} to every push/pull_request-triggered workflow lacking one, matching the dasomel/openforge house convention

cancel-in-progress classified per job side effects: true for test/lint/scan-only workflows (agent-behavior, ci, e2e-airgap, codeql); false (group added, no cancel) for workflows that mutate external state (cleanup-merged-branch deletes a branch ref; scorecard publishes Sigstore-signed results; release pushes/signs release images)
All edited YAML files parsed cleanly with python3 yaml.safe_load before commit; PR CI triggered the edited workflows themselves, confirming GitHub Actions also parses them without error
Concurrency guards added to 7 workflows; dependabot-licenses.yaml (already had one) and publish-openforge-status.yml (workflow_dispatch-only, no push/pull_request trigger) left untouched
